extra_quotes: 2D NbOCl2 flakes with different layer thicknesses were obtained by mechanical exfoliation and then transferred onto SiO2/Si substrates for further characterization.
2D/1D NbOCl2/AgNW hybrids were prepared by a dry transfer method.
Raman and SHG measurements were carried out at room temperature in a confocal Raman spectrometer system (WiTec Alpha 300R, Oxford instrument).

The morphology and thickness of exfoliated 2D NbOCl2 flakes were characterized by combining optical microscope (Eclipse LV150N, Nikon) and atomic force microscope system (Asylum Research MFP-3D, Oxford, UK) with an AFM tip (Micromesh HQ:NSC14, k = 5) working at AC mode.
Electric-field-induced phase transition experiments were conducted by a combined semiconductor parameter analyzer (B1500A, Keysight) and SHG spectrometer system.
